body:
FOUND TWICE ON 2026-08-05, both times by T143's work, neither time fixed by it:

1. The independent premortem of the origin-null repair named it: ownOrigins is exactly the settled
   public URL's origin (loopback-widened, session.ts ~399-430). Behind the rehearsed funnel shape
   (TLS on 8443 in front of the store), a --public-url that disagrees with the address the browser
   actually uses — scheme, host or port — makes every Origin-bearing POST refuse with the same 403
   T143 produced. Every rail is green, because every rail runs loopback where agreement holds by
   construction.
2. The browser rail's own fixture hit the dependency immediately: it could not use port 0, because
   publicUrl must name the port before listen. The rail reserves a port first and states why
   (test/browser/door-smoke.test.ts). That comment is the only place the dependency is written down.

TWO DELIVERABLES, either or both:

(a) A LOUD FAULT instead of a silent 403: when a refused POST's Origin differs from every member of
    ownOrigins only in scheme or port (host equal), say once — onFault — that --public-url likely
    disagrees with the address the browser used, naming both. This is a report-honesty change: it
    refuses exactly as before and explains itself. Rate/dedup like the scrypt-cost fault: say it on
    TRANSITION, not per attempt, so a stranger cannot fill a log.
(b) A FUNNEL-FIXTURE STORY RAIL: one browser story through a local TLS-terminating proxy (self-signed,
    Chrome launched with --ignore-certificate-errors or the cert installed in the test profile),
    asserting login succeeds when --public-url names the funnel address and refuses-with-the-fault
    when it does not. Two-sided by construction.

START WITH (a); it is small and pays immediately. (b) rides on test/browser/cdp.ts, which already
exists.

WHO MERGES: (a) makes a report more honest and self-merges on the ordinary bar. (b) is a rail
addition, same bar. Neither widens what any door admits.

WHY NOW: ~/.loam as Myk's primary store serves through exactly this funnel shape (the rehearsed
recipe), so the first real deploy is the first place this bites a human.
title: Origin-agreement behind a TLS terminator has no rail — a wrong --public-url is a silent universal 403, diagnosed by nobody
